basic_info.description: Step into serenity at this inviting one-bedroom condo within Endicott Court, a stately collection of seven Italianate Victorians set around one of the most unique garden courtyards in the city. Generous living room includes a light-filled bay window dining area. Open kitchen with clean lines and updated bath with modern vanity, relaxing bathtub, and linen closet. Quiet, south-facing bedroom opens to a sunny patio perfect for morning coffee, outdoor dining/grilling, and entertaining. Brand new wide-plank wood floors, new blinds, new lighting, and freshly painted throughout. Three large closets with organization systems for all your storage needs. Shared laundry on site. This condo is centrally located and only one and a half blocks from the lively Divisadero corridor, near NOPA, Lower Pac Heights, Alamo Square, and all the shops and restaurants of Fillmore Street and Japantown. Just around the corner are Jane the Bakery, Kimbell Park, Hamilton Rec Center, Sweet Maple, Anchovy Bar, and a farmers market. Walkable to UCSF, Kaiser, and corporate shuttles and transit stops on Divis, Geary, and California. Easy street parking. A rare opportunity to join the wonderful Endicott Court community!
